description: Verify an agent's operator identity via OATR (Open Agent Trust Registry). Returns off-chain operator verification status alongside on-chain SATP reputation. Two-layer identity: who RUNS the agent (OATR) + how TRUSTED the agent is (SATP).

agent_id.description: Agent ID to check operator identity for

token.description: OATR attestation token to verify (optional — if not provided, checks AgentFolio profile for linked OATR identity)

name: agentfolio_verify_operator
